notes.title: New patch live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537813/791ed3e38b991aacc66c1a6de2a51fa5708cde54.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Updated Pittsburgh layout after the SX IRL event
[*] Updated Denver layout after the SX IRL event
[*] Updated Salt Lake City layout after the SX IRL event
[*] Implemented the Dynamic Cornering Camera toggle: you can now toggle on/off the default dynamic camera (or "look to apex" system). Go to Game Experience to adjust this feature.
[*] Added active collisions in Ranked Seasons matched
[*] Implemented track voting in private lobbies.
[*] Untethered transmission selection from game experience: the transmission selection will now stand out from the default game experience levels. This will impact online private lobbies too.
[*] Increased Ranked Races penalities: addressed an issue where players exploited a too small fee to pay withdrawing from a ranked match. In addition, in 2 people matches, the withdrawal now will still shut down the match but who will leave will incur in a harsher penalty. 
[*] Updated the default community UGC filter: the default page now will display the community creations first, facilitating the browsing of the UGC content list.
[*] Implemented film grain option: go to Settings → Image Configuration to activate it
[*] Revisited riders' power rankings to match IRL standings.
[*] Minor fixes and polishing.
[*] Improved stability and performance.
[/list]

notes.title: New patch LIVE!
notes.content:
New patch live on #Supercross25! 🛠️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537813/8a5bed21d272f69ba38aea01056d9845441b49b4.png[/img]

- Updated Seattle track layout after the SX IRL event

- Updated Philadelphia track layout after the SX IRL event

- Updated East Rutherford track layout after the SX IRL event

- Improved Semi-Automatic Weight: with this help active players can now to turn sharper and with more stability than before. This is the most important helper for new players and we wanted to boost its impact in the gameplay

- Ranked Season: QOL improvements and bug fixes

- Minor fixes and polishing

- Improved stability and performance
